LESSON: SONGS

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PERFORMING
Topic 1.1: Songs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Songs. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: When is the national types of songs performed anthem sung?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. sing 3-part rounds, keeping verses of the Kenya National Anthem in to the respective parts for English and or Kiswahili paying enjoyment attention to posture and appropriate

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: SONGS
This lesson teaches Songs for Grade 3 MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. sing 3-part rounds, keeping verses of the Kenya National Anthem in to the respective parts for English and or Kiswahili paying enjoyment attention to posture and appropriate
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Songs using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Songs above.
2. Explain Songs to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Songs.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Songs with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Songs important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. When is the national types of songs performed anthem sung?
2. when singing b) sing a variety of age songs, action songs, sacred songs and the national anthem?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. sing 3-part rounds, keeping verses of the Kenya National Anthem in to the respective parts for English and or Kiswahili paying enjoyment attention to posture and appropriate

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
